scripts.copy:neptune: rm -rf www/vendor/neptune && mkdir -p www/vendor/neptune/fonts && cp -R node_modules/@transferwise/neptune-css/dist/css www/vendor/neptune/ && cp -R node_modules/@transferwise/neptune-css/dist/props www/vendor/neptune/ && cp -R node_modules/@transferwise/neptune-css/dist/img www/vendor/neptune/ && for f in inter-cyrillic-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 inter-cyrillic-ext-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 inter-greek-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 inter-greek-ext-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 inter-latin-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 inter-latin-ext-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 inter-vietnamese-variable-wghtOnly-normal.woff2 WiseSans-Heavy.woff2; do cp "node_modules/@transferwise/neptune-css/dist/fonts/$f" "www/vendor/neptune/fonts/$f"; done
scripts.copy:globe: rm -rf www/vendor/globe && mkdir -p www/vendor/globe && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.js node_modules/topojson-client/dist/topojson-client.min.js node_modules/world-atlas/land-50m.json www/vendor/globe/
scripts.prebuild:css: pnpm run copy:neptune && pnpm run copy:globe
scripts.postinstall: pnpm run copy:neptune && pnpm run copy:globe
